text:
You need a results-driven Sales Representative who can engage potential clients, present AI products clearly, and help drive sales growth.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is analytical, that has made me especially effective at understanding product value, structuring information clearly, and communicating insights in a way that helps people make decisions.

One project that reflects this is my Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture in retail. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a single, streamlined view of sales performance, and monthly close reporting dropped from 3 days to 4 hours. That work required careful attention to business needs, clear presentation of information, and the ability to turn complex data into something easy to understand and act on.

For your AI products, I would bring the same structured, client-focused approach to the sales process. I understand how important it is to present value clearly, adapt messaging to different audiences, and stay organized while managing outreach and follow-up. My experience working with dashboards and reporting has trained me to be precise, responsive, and focused on outcomes.

I’m confident I can help communicate your product’s strengths in a way that supports sales conversations and builds trust with potential clients. I’m comfortable working in fast-moving environments where clarity, consistency, and follow-through matter.

What kind of AI products are you selling, and who is your primary target customer?
